Game Overview

Astro Blaster is a pixel game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Astro Blaster doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Astro Blaster?

Astro Blaster is a free pixel game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Astro Blaster free to play?

Yes, Astro Blaster is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
